title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Grok 4.6 Leads CursorBench: xAI released Grok 4.6, taking the #1 ranking on CursorBench 3.2 for real-world coding benchmarks ahead of Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol.
Berkshire Boosts Stake 83%: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway expanded its holdings in Alphabet () to $37.8 billion.
DHH's $1.5M AWS S3 Exit Storage Trade: DHH highlighted 37signals' 2025 purchase of 19 PB flash storage for $1.5M, now valued at $19M amid global flash supply shifts.
U.S. Earnings Outpace Stock Price Gains: Financial reporting indicates corporate earnings growth is outstripping price appreciation across major U.S. equities.
Desktop AI & Autonomous Tooling Advances: OpenAI added Computer History memory to desktop ChatGPT, while Nous Research introduced /loop automation and ChatCut debuted local AI video editing.
